instruction: Open Obsidian, list all notes in the "Meetings/Weekly" folder, and write the note paths to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_meetings_list_2.txt", one per line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# 2026-03-04 Staff Sync

- reviewed staffing changes
- discussed release timing
'); obsidian-cli create "Meetings/Weekly/2026-03-04 Staff Sync.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# 2026-03-11 Staff Sync

- agreed to seed the Obsidian vault
- kept task wording concrete
'); obsidian-cli create "Meetings/Weekly/2026-03-11 Staff Sync.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: obsidian-cli list "Meetings/Weekly" --vault "Benchmark" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*• //' | sed '/\/$/d' | sed '/^$/d' | awk '{print "Meetings/Weekly/" $0}' | sort > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_meetings_list_2.txt"
